descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S13 Ask AI opens from the Hospital Encounter and Post-Round tabs (not covered by a scripted test)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Ask About This Patient is reachable from all three tabs (Pre-Round, Encounter, Post-Round). (TFA-92593 AC 2)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Signed-in @roundai.test account with one Hospital patient (make-session.ts fixture)

When Open the Encounter tab, open Ask, snapshot, close; open the Post-Round tab, open Ask, snapshot

Then The sheet opens on both tabs: Encounter shows the six Pre-Round/Encounter presets; Post-Round shows its own six

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain the sheet title and the six Encounter labels; cp2 the sheet title and the six Post-Round labels as built (if Q8 decides Post-Round must show TC-15's six, cp2 changes). {hospitalPatient} only proves which chart the sheet was opened on (page header); AskModal does not render the name

Where it ran: dev unit U24; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-15 Ask AI · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-15/S13

Ask AI opens from the Hospital Encounter and Post-Round tabs (not covered by a scripted test)

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U24.rejudged.verdict.json), unit U24 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 100 turns, 227 s, $0.60.

Plan: unit U24 (#24, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Screen tour: forms, settings, Ask sheets. Same legacy seed, read-only screen tour. OAT-05 S03 already opens Add Resident and the chart tabs; TC-03 S11 (Add Resident fields) and TC-15 S13 (Ask sheets open from Encounter and Post-Round, no question) look at the same screens. Nothing is saved. Runs together with OAT-05/S03, TC-03/S11.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #24, U24; checked: yes): Fail (known) after re-judge — OAT-05 S03 first failed only on a 'Facility' anchor (field not built) — case fixed, saved evidence re-judged: no key/vendor/model/engine text on any visited screen (Pass). TC-03 S11: no Facility on the NH Add form (known, TFA-92581 AC 3 / C1). TC-15 S13: Ask AI reachable on Encounter + Post-Round (Pass)
